note: Reports the claim by Tristan Buckmaster (NYU) and Levent Alpöge (Anthropic) that the Navier–Stokes equations can blow up in finite time with no external force, posted with a 79-page paper and a Lean formalisation of about 600,000 lines written with Claude and Codex. It notes the work is not peer-reviewed and that a numerical certificate the proof relies on, checked outside Lean, had not yet been released.
title: Navier-Stokes can blow up with no outside force, Buckmaster and Alpöge say
